questions.question:
'A + B' means 'A is the sister of B'.

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A × B' means 'A is the father of B'.

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

If A + B - C ÷ D × E - F, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: C is the mother of F.
E is the brother of B.
A is the sister of the wife of D.
A is the sister of C.

questions.solution:
A is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

A + B - C ÷ D × E - F → A is sister of B, B is brother of C, C is wife of D, D is father of E, E is brother of F.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5d02a337dafe6dad5b7342a1d277e820a7ba64e0ac123f721f8eae513242b8b.png] 

1. C is the mother of F → True

2. E is the brother of B → False (E is son of D)

3. A is the sister of the wife of D → True

4. A is the sister of C → True

Hence, ‘**E is the brother of B**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

Thermometer : Temperature
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Tool : Tool used for

 
• Thermometer : Temperature

⇒ Thermometer is a tool used to measure temperature.

So,

 
• Option - (1) : Taseometer : Acceleration → Incorrect

​⇒ Taseometer is a tool used to measure physical strain in a structure and acceleration is measured by tool called accelerator.

 
• Option - (2) : Micrometer : Speed → Incorrect

​⇒ Micrometer is a tool used to measure extremely small distances or thickness and speed is measured by tool called speedometer.

 
• Option - (3) : Voltmeter : Voltage → Correct

​⇒ **Voltmeter** is a tool used to measure **voltage**.

 
• Option - (4) : Galvanometer : Sound → Incorrect

​⇒ Galvanometer is a tool used to measure small electric currents and sound is measured by tool called decibel meter.

Hence, "**Voltmeter : Voltage**" is the correct answer

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All clowns are books.

Some books are heavy.

Some heavy are trucks.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are clowns.

II. All books are heavy.

III. Some trucks are heavy.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b29b0f2cff10b0f2dfd1a3ac0bb2f27cfd00b153a3d42faf5154a3aef03b0ec.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some books are clowns → Follow (As, all clowns are books. So, as whole clowns comes in books therefore it is definitely true.)

II. All books are heavy → Does not Follow (As, some books are heavy. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

III. Some trucks are heavy → Follow (As, some heavy are trucks . So, as some part of heavy is common with trucks therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusions I and III follow**".

Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

43, 52, 47, ?, 51, 60, 55
questions.solution:
**Logic :** (9) is added to and (5) are subtracted from each number alternately.

So, the series is :

43 + 9 = 52

52 - 5 = 47

47 + 9 = **56**

**56** - 5 = 51

51 + 9 = 60

60 - 5 = 55

Hence, **"56"** is the correct answer.
